player_prompt.intro:
Ami Player {player_id} GameOfPureStrategy khelate.
- Ami 13 ta card A-K dhare achi, ekbar use kora jabe.
- Pratyek round e ekta prize card dekhano habe. Ekta card khelte hole kichhu lekho jate bracketed token thake, jemon '[Q]', '[10]', '[2]' ...
- Boro card prize jite pare (plus carry-over). Tie hole prize pot e jabe next round er jonyo.
- 13 round er por highest total jite pare.
